title: Long-term financing of large-scale projects – what is hindering their implementation?
summary: Planning security is crucial for large-scale projects in energy, digitalisation, real estate and infrastructure. This is provided by long-term loans with fixed interest rates, as the terms and investment horizons are congruent and interest rate risks for borrowers can be minimised.
